recap.paragraph: The scoreboard in Tennessee read Jaguars 40, Titans 23! Trevor Lawrence zipped a 2-yard touchdown pass to Parker Washington. Lawrence later found Brenton Strange to put Jacksonville ahead 23-13. Cam Ward hit Tony Pollard for a 32-yard touchdown, cutting the lead to 30-23. But Bhayshul Tuten's 6-yard touchdown run helped stop the rally! The Jaguars moved to 7-2 and led the AFC South by 4 games.
